portInfo.description: Horta on Faial is the Azores’ classic mid-Atlantic yachting crossroads and an occasional cruise call. Portos dos Açores has publicly discussed improving port spaces that serve Horta Marina. Captured pages do not provide a cruise-ship quay LOA/depth table distinct from marina infrastructure, so capacity stays unverified. Treat tender vs alongside as line-declared until a berth sheet is captured.
portInfo.location: Located on Faial Island, Azores, Portugal

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Terminal located in Horta town center
gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-15 minutes to most attractions—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Terminal located in Horta town center

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Atlantic swell — confirm tender status early.
